title: Brain implants link experiencers to the gray hive mind

tellings.quote: It turns you into a walking bug and it and it connects you to the gray hive of mind. They told me that too.

plain: Implants put in the brains of people who say they have met aliens connect them to the "gray hive mind," a shared mind of the grays, the small grey beings of many abduction stories, and "it turns you into a walking bug." Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels this as something he was told directly: "They told me that too."
